request: I want to go on a trip with my family over spring, March 19-29. Preferably a nice retreat. I want to feel good because life has been stressful recently. Outdoors stuff.

4 bases, Höfn, Akureyri, Borgarnes, Vík í Mýrdal: from Vík í Mýrdal alone it would be no less travel, 2 fewer of these places within reach; the 3 moves cost about 17 h 45 in all. It takes these stays to follow the route. The hotel changes you allow cannot follow the whole route: Egilsstaðir is beyond a day's reach of where you stay.

One day is lighter than it should be: Sidequest could not put 3 of the places it found and a place to sleep (Reykjavík) on the map. That is Sidequest's to fix — nothing for you to do.
